inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text: They’re once again putting Terry Pheto in the frame, this time through claims aired at a parliamentary briefing on 24 March 2026 about an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal. The SIU investigation gives the story an official stamp, but that doesn’t mean the public is being shown the whole picture. When institutions choose to spotlight one person, it’s worth asking whether she’s being made the convenient face of a much wider funding mess—and who benefits from keeping attention there.
